exposure: Women who ceased breastfeeding due to medication intake
Professional counseling on medication use during breastfeeding
cohort: 847 women recruited from five healthcare institutions in 2020
finding: Erroneous professional advice on medication compatibility with breastfeeding was a significant factor in breastfeeding cessation, highlighting the need for evidence-based counseling.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was a factor significantly correlated with breastfeeding discontinuation due to medication intake.
